content:
Each knight move changes the sum \(|x|+|y|\) by at most \(3\). The target has
\[
|1991|+|1991|=3982,
\]
so at least
\[
\left\lceil \frac{3982}{3}\right\rceil = 1328
\]
moves are needed.

This bound is achievable: take  
- \(662\) moves of type \((2,1)\),
- \(665\) moves of type \((1,2)\),
- \(1\) move of type \((2,-1)\).

Then the net displacement is
\[
662(2,1)+665(1,2)+1(2,-1)=(1991,1991).
\]
Thus the minimum number of moves is \(\boxed{1328}\).
